meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: Claude 会用 HTML 来构建视频项目:按规范设置画面时序、让框架控制媒体播放,并遵守确定性渲染与验证规则,从而生成可渲染的视频。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或修改 HyperFrames 项目时,涉及 composition HTML 结构、data-* 时序属性、媒体播放等场景,该技能会启用。

howto.what_en: Claude will build video projects as HTML, setting scene timing per spec, letting the framework own media playback, and following deterministic render and validation rules to produce a renderable video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create or edit a HyperFrames project—covering composition HTML structure, data-* timing attributes, media playback, and similar scenarios.
